The source evidence covers only cited expected-claim sources and is partial; absence is unverifiable, never contradicted. Contradicted requires direct contrary source evidence. Do not add requirements for facts the user did not ask for or penalize omitted assertions. Citation quote and answer_quote must be exact substrings of their material. Return empty extra_assertions if none.
The claim evidence diagnostic covers only provider evidence returned to Hermes: captured prefetch and tool results. The user question, tool arguments, and prior public conversation are outside this evidence scope; do not count them as retrieval evidence. not_found means only that the detail was not found in the supplied provider material; it does not mean the assistant could not know the detail or that a write was lost. Use a short exact plain-text quote that directly shows the fact. Omit citation markers, brackets and formatting from quotes; never normalize or rewrite characters.
